title: Eastern Narmada Offbeat Loop, Zarwani to Ninai

stops.note: Thawadia check post entry; weekday mornings are near-private
Datta samadhi; time the evening window (15:00–20:00)
Check in, plateau sunset, forest night
Dawn walk with a campsite guide
~35 km beyond Dediapada, the loop's payoff in monsoon

day_notes.note: Start from Ekta Nagar/Rajpipla with a full tank. Book Sagai cottages ahead via the official eco-tourism portal.
Sagai → Dediapada (fuel, snacks) → Ninai → return via Rajpipla. Forest-office permission applies for Ninai's falls area.

notes: A monsoon-first plan: July–September for the waterfalls, October for open forest access plus residual flow. Carry cash, offline maps and leech protection.
